stories.headline: Mercedes clinch a ninth Formula One constructors' title
stories.summary: Mercedes have won the Formula One World Constructors' Championship for the ninth time, sealing it at the São Paulo Grand Prix at the Interlagos Circuit on 8 November. It is their first constructors' title since 2021. Lando Norris of McLaren took pole position in a wet qualifying session and went on to win the race.

stories.headline: M. John Harrison wins the 2026 Booker Prize
stories.summary: The English author M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything. The award is worth £50,000 and goes to the best English-language novel published in the United Kingdom or Ireland. His earlier work includes the Viriconium sequence and the Kefahuchi Tract trilogy.

stories.headline: South Korea fines two food-delivery platforms
stories.summary: The South Korean Fair Trade Commission has fined the food-delivery platforms Woowa Brothers and Coupang. Woowa Brothers was fined ₩331.1 billion, about US$247 million, and Coupang ₩300.8 billion, about $222 million. The regulator found that the platforms restricted competition by requiring restaurants to match rival platforms' terms.

stories.headline: Why bitter coffee comes to taste good
stories.summary: Researchers have described a slow dopamine pathway that links the digestive system and the brain. It lets the brain learn about the benefits of a food after it has been eaten, rather than from the first taste alone. Once the brain connects the taste of coffee with caffeine's effects, they say, the coffee starts to taste better.
